title: Customer sample-driven quant tuning + safety rollback plan
creator: Marissa Chen
description: Support-led bespoke calibration for a regulated customer who observed accuracy regressions after enabling default FP8 profiles for a financial NER model. Goal: run a sample-driven calibration sweep, propose per-layer scale adjustments and safe rollback pathways so customer can remain online with quantized models while meeting their SLA for accuracy.
customer_request_summary: Customer submitted a request for an exception to the standard FP8 profile after a 2.1% drop in named-entity-recognition F1 on their proprietary transaction dataset. They require deterministic rollback steps and an auditable calibration report for compliance teams.
acceptance_criteria: Quantized model F1 degradation <= 0.3% relative to baseline on customer's holdout (stratified by high-risk segments)
Calibration procedure documented with per-layer scale factors and deterministic seed state for reproducibility
Rollback plan validated end-to-end (deploy quant-disabled variant and confirm identical inference results) within 10 minutes of execution
Customer-signed calibration report and audit logs uploaded to secure bucket
steps: Ingest customer-provided sample (10k labeled examples). Verify schema and tokenize with runtime tokenization match.
Split sample into stratified folds: high-value transactions, low-value, OOD patterns (70/15/15). Create deterministic seeds.
Run baseline float32 evaluation to confirm reported baseline metrics and capture token length distributions.
Run FP8 calibration sweep with per-layer min-max and histogram collectors (3 candidate profiles: default, high-dynamic-range, per-layer rescales).
Evaluate each candidate on holdout folds; calculate F1, precision, recall, and per-class deltas. Log metrics and raw logits for differential analysis.
If FP8 candidates fail acceptance, run fallback INT8 affine calibration with symmetric/asymmetric clamps and a conservative per-channel option.
Propose a final profile and generate a deterministic artifact (quant-profile JSON + seed). Produce an ops playbook to flip traffic with canary and instant rollback switches.
Conduct dry-run deploy in staging (private vpc) and run smoke tests + canary customer queries; collect latency/cost deltas.
Deliver calibration report to customer and schedule compliance walkthrough; onboard customer to monitor alerts for 72-hour window post-deploy.
test_results_summary: Baseline float F1: 0.821. Default FP8 profile produced F1: 0.799 (-0.022). Best FP8 candidate (per-layer rescale) achieved F1: 0.819 (-0.002). INT8 fallback candidate achieved F1: 0.820 (-0.001) but increased p50 latency by 15ms. Cost delta: FP8 best - 12% CPU/GPU token cost, INT8 fallback - 20% cost saving vs float but with higher latency.
safety_checks: Per-query integrity check: verify token-level outputs are deterministic when running quant-disabled variant
Threshold alert: if post-deploy rolling F1 drop > 0.5% trigger automated rollback
Audit log retention: calibration artifacts + seeds retained for 365 days
Access control: calibration artifacts writeable only by eng/ops and customer-sops group
fallbacks: Immediate deploy revert to pinned float32 model variant (route-based traffic switch) — verified 3-step runbook
Fallback to INT8 conservative profile with layer-wise clamps if FP8 shows regression in production
Route high-risk customer queries to dedicated float pool until stability window passes
